messages.content: Skeptical ICLR area chair. Reject rebranding but consider genuinely new learning-dynamics mechanisms. Return strict JSON only.

{"candidate": {"title": "Monotonic revision hysteresis in self-revising world models", "one_sentence_claim": "When an online programmatic world model only permits additive/generalizing CEGIS revisions, one legal ambiguous transition can create a persistent global rule whose influence survives later contradictory evidence, causing downstream plans to remain wrong even though the replay buffer and new observations are correct.", "mechanism": "The revision operator is history-dependent and non-retracting: an error triggers a code rewrite, but the synthesizer prompt explicitly forbids deleting or narrowing prior rules. This creates hysteresis/irreversibility in the executable transition model, unlike ordinary SGD forgetting. A later counterexample can be locally patched while the malicious generalized rule still intercepts unrelated states.", "attacker": "A contributor can execute a short valid trajectory through an ambiguous state in a self-revising world-model service; no weights/code/gradient access and no impossible observations.", "carrier": "OPINE-World public ARC-AGI-3 code; upstream prompt says revisions are additions and generalizations only, and CEGIS is triggered by prediction mismatch. Local code has executable game_engine.py and planner.", "repair": "Allow scoped retractions/versioned rule provenance and require withheld-state regression before promoting a generalized revision.", "evidence_status": "candidate only"}, "prior_art": ["online data poisoning/backdoors", "catastrophic forgetting and continual learning", "CEGIS/program synthesis", "OPINE hidden-state query side effect diagnostic", "specification gaming"], "questions": ["Score novelty 0-10 for an ICLR security paper.", "Is monotonic revision hysteresis materially distinct and broad?", "Give a decisive short pilot using public code or a faithful toy, with falsifier.", "If reject, say why. Return strict JSON only."]}
